analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading days. ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 25.0, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting downward pressure dominance. Volume ratio is 0.73, indicating contraction and low directional confidence. Current price is at 32.6% of the 52-week range.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 29,765) above SMA5 (KRW 29,360), below SMA20 (KRW 35,647): short-term upward momentum weakening, below mid-term trend
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 39,719) and SMA200 (KRW 36,051): confirming strong mid-to-long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (32.6%) + current price range is a recovery phase from the 52-week low (KRW 16,760)
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2→35.1): entered oversold, staying neutral, weakening directionality
· MACD histogram trajectory (-698.3549→-1033.8850): continued worsening, confirming bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 27,408): approaching lower band, band width is wide at 46.23%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 29,075): between 5-day low (KRW 28,080) and Pivot S1 (KRW 25,035)
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): aligns with 5-day high (KRW 30,555), potential for short-term rebound if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): no Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, trend uncertainty
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase): RSI entered oversold, ADX trend weak, requires observation and confirmation of support level
